annotations.title: Check that a profile links to the page

description: Reads each connected Instagram and Facebook profile's website through the network's API and says whether it holds the link page's address (either address the page answers at, tagged or not). Instagram's API shares one website, so a page added as a second or later link reads as not linked. The first match for an account is logged, which ticks the page's "Put it in your bio" step (today_summary link_page.in_bio).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

network.description: Only this network's profiles; left out, both

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_profile_check
